communication.label: Communication
communication.low: Important things often go unsaid or get misread. Try a short weekly check-in with no phones.
communication.mid: You talk, but not always about what matters. Practice naming feelings, not just facts.
communication.high: You listen and share openly. Keep making room for it when life gets busy.

trust.label: Trust
trust.low: Doubt or secrecy is wearing on the relationship. Name specific worries calmly and agree on what openness means.
trust.mid: Trust is mostly there but has soft spots. Consistency in small promises rebuilds it fastest.
trust.high: You feel safe with each other. Keep honoring small commitments.

conflict.label: Conflict handling
conflict.low: Arguments escalate or get avoided. Agree on a pause signal and return to the topic after cooling down.
conflict.mid: You resolve most disagreements, but some patterns repeat. Look for the need behind the recurring topic.
conflict.high: You disagree without damaging the bond. Keep repairing quickly after rough moments.

intimacy.label: Closeness
intimacy.low: You may feel distant emotionally or physically. Start with small daily rituals of affection and attention.
intimacy.mid: Closeness comes and goes. Protect time that is just for the two of you.
intimacy.high: You feel connected and appreciated. Keep being curious about each other.

future.label: Shared future
future.low: Your goals or values may be pulling apart. Talk openly about what each of you wants in the next few years.
future.mid: You overlap on many goals but have not discussed some big ones. Put them on the table.
future.high: You are aligned on direction and values. Revisit your plans together from time to time.
